meta.name: macOS / Native UI
meta.description: macOS 26 (Tahoe) desktop language for DubBitig: grouped content on a light window background, a floating Liquid Glass sidebar and toolbar, compact 13pt controls and the system accent for selection.
source_references: Apple Human Interface Guidelines: Color (system colors, semantic label/separator colors), Materials (Liquid Glass), Sidebars, Toolbars, Buttons, Text fields, Typography (macOS built-in text styles)
AppKit semantic colors: labelColor, secondaryLabelColor, separatorColor, windowBackgroundColor, controlBackgroundColor, controlAccentColor
HIG Accessibility: Increase Contrast system color variants

UI/UX Pro Max styles.csv: liquid-glass ('apply sparingly to navigation and controls, keep content on a separate layer, test reduced transparency'); stacks/swiftui.csv: NavigationSplitView for multi-column apps

color.palette_type: monochromatic neutrals with a single system accent

primary.role: systemBlue / controlAccentColor: default push button, sidebar selection, focus ring, links

secondary.role: pressed / hover state of the accent

neutral.usage: #FFFFFF grouped boxes, text fields and buttons; #F6F6F6 raised rows; #F2F2F2 window/content background; #EBEBED sidebar glass base; #E5E5E5 separators; #E3E3E8 hover; #D1D1D6 control borders; #86868B placeholder; #737378 tertiary label raised for 4.5:1; #6E6E73 secondary label; #262626 label (85% black)

color.contrast_strategy: dark-on-light dominant with grouped white boxes on light grey; text colours use Increase Contrast variants of the system colours

dark_mode.neutral_usage: #1E1E1E window/content background; #2C2C2E grouped boxes; #2A2A2C sidebar glass base; #333336 raised rows; #3A3A3C hover and buttons; #38383A separators; #48484A control borders; #98989D tertiary label; #A1A1A6 secondary label; #DFDFDF label (85% white); #161617 text fields

accessible_text_variants.note: Official values below WCAG AA 4.5:1 as text on these surfaces, nudged toward black (light) or white (dark) keeping the hue; enforced by tests/design-dna.test.ts.

font_families.heading: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", "SF Pro", "Inter", "Helvetica Neue", "Noto Sans", system-ui, sans-serif
font_families.body: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "SF Pro", "Inter", "Helvetica Neue", "Noto Sans", system-ui, sans-serif

typography.font_style_notes: Neo-grotesque system font, 13pt body (macOS standard), slight negative tracking on titles, bold titles; section headers are small semibold sentence case, not uppercase.

layout.grid_system: NavigationSplitView: inset sidebar, content list, detail (inspector)

shape.border_usage: hairline separators; controls have a 0.5–1px edge plus a faint drop shadow
shape.divider_style: 1px separatorColor, inset from the leading edge in lists

elevation.depth_cues: blur/glass for navigation and controls, shadows for windows and sheets

iconography.style: SF Symbols-like regular weight line icons
iconography.preferred_set: SF Symbols (app keeps Phosphor/Lucide regular weight)

motion.entrance_pattern: sheets slide down from the toolbar and fade; popovers scale from 0.96

components.button_style: Push button: white (dark: #3A3A3C) fill, hairline edge, faint shadow, 28px high, 13px text, 6px radius. Default button: system accent fill with a subtle top-to-bottom gradient and white text. Toolbar buttons: grouped in a Liquid Glass capsule.
components.input_style: Text field: white fill, 1px border, 6px radius, 30px high; focus ring outside the field: 3.5px accent at ~45% opacity.
components.card_style: Grouped box (System Settings style): white on light grey, 10px radius, hairline border, almost no shadow.
components.navigation_pattern: Floating inset sidebar on Liquid Glass with 12px corners; rows 28px, selected row filled with the accent and white text and icon.
components.modal_style: Sheet/window: 12px radius, large soft shadow and 0.5px edge; title 15px semibold.
components.component_notes: Switch 38×22 with a white 20px knob in both states and accent track when on. Segmented controls and pickers use white raised segments on a grey track.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: content on paper, controls on a sheet of glass floating above it
aesthetic.era_influence: macOS 26 Tahoe with Liquid Glass over the Big Sur–Sequoia layout

visual_language.whitespace_usage: compact controls, generous margins around groups
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: chrome is light and translucent, content carries the weight

composition.negative_space_role: frames groups and lets glass chrome float

interaction_feel.feedback_style: subtle darkening on press, accent focus ring
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: almost none on controls; rows get a faint fill

brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: centred title, one line of help, one default button
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: calm, explains and suggests a fix

overview.fallback_strategy: disable effects: with prefers-reduced-transparency the glass becomes an opaque fill

background_effects.description: flat window background; depth comes from the glass chrome

shader_effects.description: true lensing/refraction of Liquid Glass is not reproduced

params.border_treatment: 0.5px inner highlight on top (#FFFFFF99 light / #FFFFFF1F dark), hairline outer edge in the control-border colour

visual_effects.composite_notes: Liquid Glass is applied only to navigation and controls (inset sidebar, toolbar capsule, suggestion popover) as UI/UX Pro Max advises; content cards stay opaque. Lensing/refraction would need WebGL and is approximated with blur + saturation + highlight edges. Secondary/tertiary label colours were darkened (e.g. #737378) so 12px hints keep 4.5:1. Filled surfaces that carry white text (default button, selected sidebar row) use accent_fill (#0068DA light, #0060C9 dark) because white on systemBlue is only 4.0:1 (light) and 3.6:1 (dark); rings, icons and links keep systemBlue.
